name: agent-pip
description: Engineer-led learning beside your code. Local Ollama models only — nothing leaves this machine.

pip.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama base URL. MUST be localhost — any other host is rejected in code.

pip.model.description: Primary local model. Also the Actor (generator) for Ideate improvements and POC proposals — e.g. qwen2.5-coder:14b. Benchmarked warm ~1.6s on 3b with clean chunk format.

pip.creativeModel.description: Optional model for analogies. Leave empty to use pip.model. A different model can give fresher analogies and stops them repeating the history section.

pip.webRoots.markdownDescription: Roots & history may read the introduction of one Wikipedia page for a fixed list of programming topics (for example SQL or exception handling). Only the topic title is sent, never your code or identifiers; the local model writes the story from that page. Turn off to use the built-in stories only.

pip.semanticSearch.description: Index the workspace with a local embedding model so the Solve chat can search by meaning. Needs: ollama pull nomic-embed-text. Falls back to keyword search if unavailable.

pip.embeddingModel.description: Local Ollama embedding model used for semantic search.

pip.reasoningModel.description: Reasoning model for Solve chat (debug trace) and the default Critic for Ideate verification when pip.criticModel is empty — e.g. deepseek-r1:8b. Falls back to pip.model if not installed.

pip.criticModel.description: Optional independent Critic for Ideate (generator–verifier loop). Empty uses pip.reasoningModel. Set to a different model than pip.model for cross-model debate (e.g. phi4:14b vs qwen2.5-coder:14b).

pip.fastModel.description: Model for popups / duck / solver / drills. Same default as pip.model so Ollama never swaps models (swapping is the cold-load killer).
